nodes.label: One Home Mixing Four Platforms
nodes.rationale: Hue lamps, a Home Assistant air conditioner and a Smart Life plug can sit side by side, and everything not linked stays simulated, so a home need not be replaced wholesale to adopt the app.

nodes.label: Home Assistant Integration
nodes.rationale: One local server reaches thousands of brands (Zigbee, Z-Wave, Matter, Nest, Xiaomi, Aqara, IKEA, Sonoff, SmartThings, Daikin, Mitsubishi, Tuya), and its long-lived token is the only credential needed.

nodes.label: Philips Hue Integration
nodes.rationale: Talks to the bridge's own local API after a button press, with no Hue account and no internet connection involved.

nodes.label: HomeKit Limited to App Store Mac Apps
nodes.rationale: Apple offers HomeKit to iPhone and iPad apps and to Mac apps only through the Mac App Store; since House Control is a direct download, the Mac can list Apple Home devices and link them but only the iPhone switches them.

nodes.label: Hue Trust-on-First-Use Certificate Pinning
nodes.rationale: The bridge's certificate is self-signed; the app trusts it the first time and remembers its fingerprint, so a different device answering at that address later is refused.

nodes.label: Why No Google Home, Alexa or SmartThings Yet
nodes.rationale: Alexa exposes no interface for another app to switch devices in the account; Google Home's APIs are mobile-only behind a Cloud project, Google sign-in and App Attest, and its Home MCP server is US-only; SmartThings needs a registered OAuth app and 24-hour personal tokens. Home Assistant is the practical route instead.

nodes.label: Tuya Devices in Apple Home via HomeKit Bridge
nodes.rationale: Smart Life devices are not HomeKit accessories, so the recommended free route is Home Assistant's Tuya integration plus its HomeKit Bridge; Homebridge and Matter multi-admin are alternatives.

nodes.label: Smart Life Sessions Cannot Be Shared
nodes.rationale: Tuya renews the session as it is used, so it cannot be handed between devices; Smart Life signs in separately on the Mac and on each iPhone, while Home Assistant and Hue connections sync over the encrypted link.

nodes.label: Push Event Subscriptions
nodes.rationale: Home Assistant events and the Hue bridge's event stream make a lamp switched from a wall switch, an automation or the Hue app show up within a second, instead of waiting for a poll.
